name: INCLUDE
intro: INCLUDE 是面向地域与文化知识的多语言多项选择基准，论文完整集含 197,243 题，来自 1,926 场考试、44 种语言、15 种文字和 52 个国家。数据由母语社区从学术、职业认证和地区执照考试中收集、抽取与质检，并结合既有多语言考试集，随后标注学科、层级、国家与地域性，形成完整集及标准化的 BASE/LITE 子集。
org: EPFL, Cohere For AI, Cohere For AI Community, ETH Zurich, Swiss AI Initiative
build_method: 母语社区收集考试，多格式抽取，母语者质检、过滤并做考试级元数据与地域性标注
metric: Accuracy, answer accuracy, formatting error rate
eval_feature: 地域知识、跨语言提示、5-shot 与零样本思维链
build_method_en: Native-community exam collection, multi-format extraction, native-speaker quality control, filtering, and exam-level metadata and regionality annotation
eval_feature_en: Regional knowledge, cross-language prompts, five-shot and zero-shot chain of thought
intro_en: INCLUDE is a multilingual multiple-choice benchmark for regional and cultural knowledge. The paper's complete set contains 197,243 questions from 1,926 examinations, 44 languages, 15 scripts, and 52 countries. Native-language communities collect, extract, and quality-check academic, professional-certification, and regional-license exams; the project also consolidates existing multilingual exam datasets, annotates subject, level, country, and regionality, and derives standardized BASE and LITE subsets.
metric_en: Accuracy, answer accuracy, formatting error rate

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2411.19799v1, INCLUDE-BASE revision d2e1f6015f67a43c02a9a68db98e2298e2d6a660, and INCLUDE-LITE revision a027ccc923428c0c43c295a91efcc39a1e47fa60. The paper's complete INCLUDE set contains 197,243 MCQA pairs from 1,926 examinations, 44 languages, 15 scripts, 52 countries, and 58 knowledge domains, but the complete 197,243-entry set is held back for incremental release. Native-speaker communities collect academic exams, professional certifications, and regional licenses. PDF, JavaScript/HTML, and other extraction pipelines produce questions, options, and correct answers; native speakers compare them with originals, correct errors, remove image/table-dependent items, and preserve required reference context. The exact accounting is 118,606 newly parsed and verified questions (60.2%) plus 78,637 questions from ArabicMMLU, ChineseMMLU, TurkishMMLU, PersianMMLU, VNHSGE, and EXAMS. Labels are assigned at exam level rather than sample level, using a two-level academic taxonomy and regionality shares of agnostic 34.4%, explicit 18.8%, cultural 16.4%, and implicit 30.4%. The paper subsets contain BASE 22,635 and LITE 10,770 four-option MCQAs. At the pinned public revisions, BASE exposes 23,741 test plus 915 validation rows, while LITE exposes 11,021 rows; these mutable public totals are kept separate from the paper snapshot. Evaluation uses temperature 0, 5-shot with 512 tokens or zero-shot CoT with 1,024 tokens, in-language or English prompts with optional region prefixes, and reports total accuracy, answer accuracy, and formatting errors.
